## Agent interpretations (labelled)

- **Current state, not targets.** L3 §6.2 and plan §6.6 give post-Round-11 verdicts. Where the surface still contradicts them the matrix records today's verdict and puts the target in the note: SIG-EVAL-001 stays PARTIAL (the `/methodology/` "human-verified holdout" claim, F2b live-read 2026-09-30, blocks MET-ENGINEERED until P34.45); SIG-EVAL-003 AT-RISK-INTEGRATION and SIG-EVAL-006 MISSING (target MET after P37.44); SIG-IDENT-030 PARTIAL (a statistic ships today; P34.15); SIG-EPIS-029 PARTIAL and SIG-RECON-018 AT-RISK-INTEGRATION (P35.25). SEED-14a's DEFERRALS statement lists EVAL-001 → D-R10-HUMAN-1 per plan §6.6; this unit did not raise it.
- **One verdict per row, clause splits in the note + `accepted_scope`.** GOV-003 = WAIVED(ADR-186) with the priority clause MET-DIFFERENTLY *once P34.17 publishes the handling order* (not yet live); PUB-008 = WAIVED(ADR-163) for the HG-11 second-reviewer role while the naming-concurrence clause stands (ADR-163 says that clause keeps a non-waiver verdict — the row's routing P35.28 carries it); UI-042 = WAIVED(ADR-179) for the release block while the review stays owed; EVAL-004 = WAIVED(ADR-153) for C0–C2 while the inferential-tier clause is met fail-safe only after P34.45 (tiers 1g/3g auto-write today, F2b). WAIVED rows carry a routing to the ticket that delivers their compensating controls.
- **SIG-CHART-025** keeps bare MET-DIFFERENTLY, routed to P34.48: F2b's MET-DIFFERENTLY(RISK) needs an ENG-005 risk row that does not exist, and the R11-A1 amendment changed the text; re-verdicting it is investigation (FEA-01).
- **Seed-owned new ids** (MEM-005, MEM-012, ENG-044 → SEED-02; ENG-041 → SEED-15; and ENG-002 → SEED-15) are routed to the SEED unit the spec names as owner; once the seed lands those routings point at a landed unit.
- **Routing to BACKLOG rows** (`BL-0nn`) is used for later-phase homes (ADR-150 D3 allows a BACKLOG home).
- **Landings**: `P34+`…`P37+` are phase buckets (the ticket ids sit in the titles because `LANDING_RE` accepts only one digit after the dot); `P38+` = the Round-11 tail (where the trigger register is swept) for revisit rows; `P39+` = after Round 11 (later-phase, trigger-gated).
